999008199.text: よーし。試作品１号、起動！
わあ……！　本当にカフェにいるみたいです！

localizations.en: Wow...! It really feels like being in a café!

999008199.text: よしよし、とりあえず見た目は成功だね

localizations.en: Good, good! The visuals are a success, at least.

999008199.text: ではお客様、お席へどうぞ
さあ、召し上がれ
いただきます！
……うーん
なんか渋い反応だね……

ええと……味も匂いもしないので、
なんだか実感が湧かなくって

localizations.en: Well... there's no taste or smell, so it doesn't quite feel real.

999008199.text: そりゃね。見た目だけだし

localizations.en: Well, yeah. It's just visual right now.

999008199.text:
本当は味覚や嗅覚も再現できたらいいんだろうけど。
それって結構難しいんでしょ？

localizations.en: It would be great if we could simulate taste and smell too, but that's pretty difficult, isn't it?

999008199.text:
はい……準備を始めてから、
ずっと調べてはいるんですけど

localizations.en: Yes... I've been researching it since we started our preparations.

999008199.text:
研究はされているようなのですが、
まだ実用化には至っていないみたいです

localizations.en: It seems there is ongoing research, but nothing that's been implemented practically yet.

999008199.text:
そこは気分だけ味わってもらうってので
いいと思うけどね。今のままでも十分インパクトあるし

localizations.en: I think it's fine if people just imagine the taste. What we have now already makes quite an impression.

999008199.text:
……でも、せっかくなら実現したいです。
もう少し考えてみます

localizations.en: ...But since we've come this far, I want to make it happen. I'll think about it some more.

999008199.text:
文化祭本番まであと２週間かあ。
時間がいくらあっても足りないね

localizations.en: There's only two weeks left until the cultural festival. It doesn't matter how much time we have - it won't be enough.

999008199.text: そうですね。でも、できる範囲で頑張ります

localizations.en: True. But we'll do our best with what we've been given.

999008199.text: お、お二人さん！　遅くまでお疲れー

localizations.en: Hey, you two! Working late, huh?

999008199.text:
おやおや、錬金術部の皆さん。
あんたらも文化祭準備の帰り？

localizations.en: Well, well, if it isn't the Alchemy Club. Are you all heading back from festival preparations too?

999008199.text:
はい！　最近はどこのクラスや部活でも
遅くまで残って作業してますよね

localizations.en: Yes! It seems like every class and club is staying late to work these days.

999008199.text:
……そういえば、噂で聞いたんですけど、
文化祭直前は学園に泊まりで作業するって本当ですか？

localizations.en: ...I've heard rumors that students actually stay overnight at the academy right before the cultural festival. Is that true?

999008199.text:
本当だよ！　大体１週間くらい前からかな？
寮生以外もみんな学園に泊まって朝まで準備するんだ

localizations.en: It sure is! Starting about a week before, everyone—even non-dormitory students—stays overnight at the academy to prepare until morning!

999008199.text: ひえー……この学園、文化祭にガチりすぎでしょ

localizations.en: Yikes... This academy takes its cultural festival way too seriously.

999008199.text: それ、本当に大丈夫なんですか？

ま、校則違反ではあるんだけど、
そこは伝統って言うか、先生たちも黙認してるみたい

localizations.en: Well, technically it breaks school rules, but it's kind of a tradition, you know? The teachers turn a blind eye to it.

999008199.text: なんだか非日常感があってワクワクします……！

localizations.en: There's just something so exciting and out of the ordinary about this...!

999008199.text: 泊まりで作業すれば、時間もいっぱい取れますね！

localizations.en: If we stay overnight to work, we'll have plenty of time!

999008199.text: あんまり無理しないでよー……？

localizations.en: Again, don't push yourself too hard, okay...?
